AC amendment: Add CI path test for github_defense_store_write with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter.

The E2E test covers local review-defense-store.sh path. Also add:
- [ ] CI path test: github_defense_store_write is called with the DROP record when PR_NUMBER is set
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_drop_ruling_writes_github_defense_record'; bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'

Add test function test_drop_ruling_writes_github_defense_record to test-arbiter-ruling-dispatch.sh:
Given: DROP ruling + PR_NUMBER set + GH_CMD=echo mock
When: the CI-mode DROP processing logic runs
Then: github_defense_store_write is called with defense_type=dropped_by_arbiter in the record JSON
